packageRules.description: Only patch updates for our maintenance branches to avoid breaking changes.
Digest updates cover all use cases since they are used as base, so we disable other types.
Exclude BPMN model dependencies which target JDK 11 (since this library targets JDK 8)
Exclude SNAPSHOT versions, renovate may suggest them for pre-release values.

Keep `java-version: 21` in the workflows and never pin a JDK patch version. Adoptium publishes each platform's binary days apart, so a pinned version breaks CI and releases on platforms that don't have it yet. With `21`, setup-java uses a 21 build that exists on each runner's platform.
Wait before proposing any freshly released version. Releases without a timestamp are not delayed, so the required Test summary check has to block them if they are not installable yet.
Automerge all updates with green CI.
